a1-lesen-01-01: The text says *erst am Nachmittag*: the two work until 13 and come in the afternoon.
a1-lesen-01-02: *Am Abend koche ich für alle*: Sabine cooks for everyone in the evening.
a1-lesen-01-03: The meeting place is *vor der Schule*; from there they go to the zoo by bus.
a1-lesen-01-04: Entry is 6 Euro, *die Busfahrt ist frei*: 6 Euro in total.
a1-lesen-01-05: *Die Kinder brauchen Essen und Trinken*: the children bring their own food.
a1-lesen-01-06: A four-year-old child needs a *Kinderbett*; a *Doppelbett* is for two adults. The number 4 in the two ads tells you the age of the bed.
a1-lesen-01-07: Weekend = *Samstag und Sonntag*. The café is looking for staff only from Monday to Friday.
a1-lesen-01-08: For a repair you need a *Fahrradwerkstatt*. The other ad sells a bike; the word *kaputt* there is only about the light.
a1-lesen-01-09: For one week you rent a car: *Autovermietung*. The other ad is selling the car (*Verkaufe*).
a1-lesen-01-10: Someone who works during the day cannot go to the 9–13 course; the evening course *18.30–20 Uhr* fits.
a1-lesen-01-11: This pharmacy is closed, but the emergency pharmacy *Rosen-Apotheke, Uferweg 12* is open all night.
a1-lesen-01-12: Children under six can go in *nur zusammen mit einem Erwachsenen*; not alone.
a1-lesen-01-13: *Dieser Automat ist leider kaputt*: you cannot get money here; the nearest one is at the station.
a1-lesen-01-14: On Sunday there are rolls *ab 8 Uhr*; *halb neun* = 8.30, so there are fresh rolls at that time.
a1-lesen-01-15: Only this lift is broken; *der Aufzug an Gleis 5* is working.
a1-lesen-02-01: *Du musst mich nicht abholen*: Omar takes the tram, so Adam does not wait at the station.
a1-lesen-02-02: The match is on Saturday *um 15.30 Uhr*; that time is in the afternoon (*Nachmittag*).
a1-lesen-02-03: There is no water only from 8 to 12; *ab Mittag ist alles wieder normal*.
a1-lesen-02-04: *Sie müssen nicht zu Hause sein*: the workers are only working in the basement.
a1-lesen-02-05: The phone hours are *Montag bis Donnerstag*; not on Friday.
a1-lesen-02-06: Evening job: *ab 18 Uhr*. The other ad is for lunch, from 10 to 15.
a1-lesen-02-07: Little money: the second-hand machine for 90 Euro fits. A new one costs at least 399 Euro; only the delivery is *gratis*.
a1-lesen-02-08: A 30-year-old is an adult: *Kurs für Erwachsene*. The other course is for children aged 5–10.
a1-lesen-02-09: For three months: *vom 1.6. bis 31.8.* The other room asks for *mindestens ein Jahr*.
a1-lesen-02-10: On Saturday Dr. Vogel is closed (Monday–Friday). *Tierklinik am Zoo* is open at the weekend too.
a1-lesen-02-11: On Thursday there is a break between 12 and 15: at 14 the doctor’s practice is closed.
a1-lesen-02-12: *Telefonieren nur im Erdgeschoss*: phone calls are allowed on the ground floor, not anywhere else.
a1-lesen-02-13: The time is the same (14.20); only the platform changes: *Gleis 7*.
a1-lesen-02-14: For cash, go to *Kasse 1 und 2*; this checkout takes cards only.
a1-lesen-02-15: *Kommen Sie gern auf ein Glas vorbei*: Mei invites her neighbours too.
a1-lesen-03-01: *Um 10 Uhr muss ich zum Zahnarzt*: a dentist is a doctor too.
a1-lesen-03-02: It is the other way round: Lena will work for Nora on Friday, and Nora for Lena on Sunday.
a1-lesen-03-03: The exam starts at 9, and you are asked to come at 8.30: half an hour earlier.
a1-lesen-03-04: *Nicht in unserer Schule, sondern in der Volkshochschule*: the exam is in another building.
a1-lesen-03-05: The results come *mit der Post* two weeks later; you do not need to go to the school.
a1-lesen-03-06: The desk that is 1,10 m wide fits into a 1,20 m space; the 1,60 m one does not.
a1-lesen-03-07: *Sonntag Ruhetag* = closed on Sunday. Café Kanal serves breakfast at the weekend.
a1-lesen-03-08: To work every day, the job with 40 hours a week fits; the other job is only two weeks in August.
a1-lesen-03-09: You sell your car to the person who is looking for one: *Suche Kleinwagen*. The person in the other ad is selling a car too.
a1-lesen-03-10: *Nachhilfe für Schüler* = private lessons for pupils. In the other ad a student is looking for help herself.
a1-lesen-03-11: It is free only *jeden ersten Sonntag im Monat*: one Sunday a month.
a1-lesen-03-12: Only for supermarket customers and for two hours at most: *maximal 2 Stunden*.
a1-lesen-03-13: *Ab 1. Februar nur noch mit Termin*: it does not work without an appointment.
a1-lesen-03-14: It is not a must: you can also leave the key with a neighbour (*oder geben Sie den Schlüssel einem Nachbarn*).
a1-lesen-03-15: The shop closes on 31 March (*wir schließen*); in April it is no longer there.
a1-lesen-04-01: The food is ready, in the fridge: *du musst es nur warm machen* (he only has to heat it up).
a1-lesen-04-02: *Wir brauchen noch Brot, das kaufe ich*: Yasemin buys the bread.
a1-lesen-04-03: *Könnt ihr bitte einen Salat oder einen Kuchen mitbringen?*: the guests are asked to bring food.
a1-lesen-04-04: *Bei Regen feiern wir in der Wohnung*: if it rains, the party is in the flat.
a1-lesen-04-05: *Bitte schreibt uns bis Mittwoch: Wie viele Personen kommen?* So they want to know how many people are coming.
a1-lesen-04-06: *Gebraucht kaufen* = buying second-hand. The other page repairs phones; it does not sell them.
a1-lesen-04-07: *Hunde willkommen*: dogs are accepted. In the other hotel: *Haustiere nicht erlaubt*.
a1-lesen-04-08: A *Bürgeramt* is a public office (*Amt*): the opening hours are on the *Ämter* page.
a1-lesen-04-09: The page that sends flowers to a home: *Wir bringen Blumen*. The other one says *kein Versand*: they do not deliver.
a1-lesen-04-10: A sports club for playing: *Neue Spieler willkommen*. On the other page you only watch the matches (*sehen*).
a1-lesen-04-11: *Bitte ohne Kinder kommen*: the parents should come without children.
a1-lesen-04-12: *Nur bar bezahlen* = cash only; cards are not accepted.
a1-lesen-04-13: On Saturday too, only until 20; 21 is too late.
a1-lesen-04-14: *Für Kinder bis 12 Jahre*: a nine-year-old child can play.
a1-lesen-04-15: The U2 does not run at the weekend; there is *Bus 140* instead.
a1-lesen-05-01: *Im Bad funktioniert sie noch*: the heating in the bathroom works.
a1-lesen-05-02: Nikos is off on Wednesday: *da geht es auch am Vormittag*; 10 is in the morning.
a1-lesen-05-03: *Der Trainer bleibt Tomasz Nowak*: the coach is the same; what changes is the day.
a1-lesen-05-04: From 17 to 18.30 = one and a half hours = 90 minutes.
a1-lesen-05-05: *Der Beitrag bleibt bei 12 Euro*: the fee does not change.
a1-lesen-05-06: There is a garden and *Haustiere erlaubt*. The other flat has only a balcony, *keine Haustiere*.
a1-lesen-05-07: If you have no driving licence, you cannot drive the rental van; the moving company *mit Fahrer* fits.
a1-lesen-05-08: An instrument (*Klavier und Gitarre*) and *ab 6 Jahren*. The choir is for ages 16 and up, and there you sing.
a1-lesen-05-09: A tailor shortens trousers: *Wir ändern Hosen*. The shop only sells new trousers.
a1-lesen-05-10: You buy a present: *Buchhandlung* (bookshop). From the library you can only borrow books (*leihen*).
a1-lesen-05-11: *24 Stunden vorher* = one day before; the appointment must be cancelled by then.
a1-lesen-05-12: Last entry is *17 Uhr*; at 17.30 nobody is let in any more.
a1-lesen-05-13: The machine takes *keine Geldscheine*: you cannot buy a ticket with banknotes.
a1-lesen-05-14: On Sunday breakfast starts at 7.30; at 7 there is none yet.
a1-lesen-05-15: Today the restaurant is open *nur für die Hochzeitsgäste*; other guests can come tomorrow.
a1-lesen-06-01: *Zwei große Koffer*: that means a lot of luggage (*Gepäck*).
a1-lesen-06-02: 5.30 + about 40 minutes = 6.10; they are there before *halb sieben* (6.30).
a1-lesen-06-03: *In dieser Zeit hilft Ihnen Frau Dr. Seidel*: during the holiday another doctor helps.
a1-lesen-06-04: 15 August is the last day of the holiday; the practice opens *ab Montag, dem 18. August*.
a1-lesen-06-05: New hours: *jetzt auch am Mittwochnachmittag* — it is open on Wednesday afternoon too.
a1-lesen-06-06: The house on the North Sea is the one that is free in August. The other one is *schon voll* in July–August and free only from September.
a1-lesen-06-07: You have no car: at the bakery, *Auto von der Firma*. The pizza place is looking for a driver *mit eigenem Auto* (with their own car).
a1-lesen-06-08: You do not eat meat: the *vegetarisch* course fits. The barbecue course has only meat.
a1-lesen-06-09: A small fridge for a small kitchen: 85 cm high, 50 cm wide. The other one is 1,85 m.
a1-lesen-06-10: A place to sell at the flea market: *Plätze für Verkäufer*. The other ad buys things at your home; there is no market.
a1-lesen-06-11: *Am Freitag ist die Kita geschlossen*: the children cannot come that day.
a1-lesen-06-13: Visiting hours are 14–19; there are no visits in the morning.
a1-lesen-06-14: *Schon ab 6 Uhr*: that day the shop opens earlier, not later.
a1-lesen-06-15: Until 30 September the road is *für Autos geschlossen*; only pedestrians and bikes can get through.
a1-lesen-07-01: It has been raining for three days: *also war ich noch nicht schwimmen* (she has not been swimming at all yet).
a1-lesen-07-02: She comes back on Sunday and works on Monday: one day after her return.
a1-lesen-07-03: *Nicht am Montag, sondern am Mittwoch*: the meeting was moved to Wednesday.
a1-lesen-07-04: *Bitte schreibt eure Wünsche vorher auf einen Zettel*: they should be written down before the meeting.
a1-lesen-07-05: *Um 17 Uhr öffnen wir wie immer*: the restaurant opens on Wednesday too.
a1-lesen-07-06: You are looking for a recipe (*Rezept*): *über 500 Rezepte*. On the café’s page you can only book a table.
a1-lesen-07-07: The price of a letter: *Preise für Briefe und Pakete in alle Länder*. The other page sells trips to Thailand.
a1-lesen-07-08: You are looking for a doctor today: addresses and consulting hours. The other page sends medicine in three days; there is no doctor.
a1-lesen-07-09: For tickets (*Karten*) there is *Ticket-Ecke*: it has sports tickets too. The other page has only results and news.
a1-lesen-07-10: You already have a profession and are looking for a job: *freie Stellen*. The other page offers three years of job training.
a1-lesen-07-11: The office sells from Monday to Thursday; not on Friday.
a1-lesen-07-12: On Saturday the bus only skips this stop; *nächste Haltestelle: Volkspark*.
a1-lesen-07-13: On Saturday *nur bis 12 Uhr*: closed in the afternoon.
a1-lesen-07-14: *Ich suche meine Katze*: their own cat is missing and they are looking for it; they do not want to buy a cat.
a1-lesen-07-15: Barbecuing is allowed *nur auf dem Grillplatz am See*: by the lake it is fine.
a1-lesen-08-01: She will stay in bed only until Wednesday; *am Donnerstag ist sie wieder da*.
a1-lesen-08-02: She is back at school on Thursday, so she is at school on Friday too; she wants to write the test.
a1-lesen-08-03: The box in front of the door is *Tag und Nacht offen*: you can leave the books there at night too.
a1-lesen-08-04: *1 Euro pro Buch*: 3 Euro a week for three books.
a1-lesen-08-05: *Sie können die Zeit einmal online verlängern*: the time can be extended once.
a1-lesen-08-06: For guests: *Schlafsofa*; opened up, it becomes a 1,40 × 2,00 m bed. The leather sofa is for two people; it is not a bed.
a1-lesen-08-07: For today: *in 10 Minuten, ohne Termin*. The other studio gives appointments for two to three weeks later.
a1-lesen-08-08: Four years is within *von 3 bis 7 Jahren*. The *Babyschale* is only for up to 12 months.
a1-lesen-08-09: Summer holidays = *Juli und August*. The supermarket is looking for staff from October.
a1-lesen-08-10: At 23 at night only the locksmith who works *Tag und Nacht* comes. The other shop closes at 18 and only copies keys.
a1-lesen-08-11: Take the 25-minute delay away from 10.40: the normal departure is 10.15.
a1-lesen-08-12: Only the machine is broken; there is coffee *in der Cafeteria im 1. Stock*.
a1-lesen-08-13: There are no tickets left for this evening, but *für morgen haben wir noch Plätze*.
a1-lesen-08-14: On Monday evening there are lessons; the registration office is open only on Tuesday and Thursday, 10–17.
a1-lesen-08-15: From May it is on Wednesday and Saturday: two days a week.
a1-lesen-09-01: The guided tour starts at 10 and ends at 12: two hours.
a1-lesen-09-02: It is free only for course participants; *alle anderen Besucher bezahlen 8 Euro*.
a1-lesen-09-03: *Ich habe Ihr Paket genommen*: the parcel is at the neighbour’s, not at the post office.
a1-lesen-09-04: *Ab 18 Uhr*: before that the neighbour is at sport; at 17 she is not at home.
a1-lesen-09-05: *Morgen bin ich den ganzen Tag im Büro*: tomorrow she is at work all day.
a1-lesen-09-06: You do not smoke: the *Nichtraucher* flat fits. In the other flat everyone smokes.
a1-lesen-09-07: Only at the weekend: *am Samstag und Sonntag*. At the other school the lessons are on weekday evenings.
a1-lesen-09-08: For 40 people: *Raum für Feste bis 60 Personen*. The bistro has only eight tables.
a1-lesen-09-09: The size matters: *Größe 128*. The other jacket is size 152, too big.
a1-lesen-09-10: The place that is open after 20: *Tag und Nacht geöffnet*. The other gym closes at 20.
a1-lesen-09-11: Lunch is until 14; at 14.30 there is none left.
a1-lesen-09-12: *Straßenschuhe bleiben im Flur*: you can go into the hall only in sports shoes.
a1-lesen-09-13: *Fester Preis 35 Euro – am Tag und in der Nacht*: the same price at night too.
a1-lesen-09-14: You can come without an appointment too, but you wait longer (*länger warten*).
a1-lesen-09-15: The day before the public holiday is Thursday: *länger geöffnet: bis 19 Uhr*.
a1-lesen-10-01: The first meeting is *am Dienstag, dem 9. Februar*; the internship itself starts in March.
a1-lesen-10-02: *Am Freitag haben Sie frei für Ihren Deutschkurs*: she does not work on Friday.
a1-lesen-10-03: *Bitte stellen Sie Ihre Räder ab sofort in den Fahrradkeller*: from now on the bikes go in the cellar.
a1-lesen-10-04: *Kinderwagen dürfen im Hausflur bleiben*: prams can stay in the hallway.
a1-lesen-10-05: This week it is the Nowak family; the Kamau family’s turn is *nächste Woche*.
a1-lesen-10-06: *Alles kostenlos* = everything is free, and it is online. The language school costs 240 Euro a month and is in a classroom.
a1-lesen-10-07: The page that finds a doctor by language: *nach Ort, Fach und Sprache*. The other one is an Arabic course.
a1-lesen-10-08: Giving things away (*verschenken*): *Geben und nehmen – alles gratis*. The other page sells new furniture.
a1-lesen-10-09: In the rain the museum works, and it is open on Sunday too. The playground is open *nur bei gutem Wetter*.
a1-lesen-10-10: *Führerschein aus dem Ausland* = a driving licence from abroad: the information you need is here. The other page buys and sells cars.
a1-lesen-10-11: *Anmeldung ab sofort*: registration for the April course is already open.
a1-lesen-10-12: *Wir suchen Verkäufer/innen und Fahrer/innen*: the supermarket is looking for staff.
a1-lesen-10-13: Guests who come late call ahead and the key is left in the box: you can get into your room after 22 too.
a1-lesen-10-14: *Wir rufen Sie mit Ihrer Nummer*: they call your number, not your name.
a1-lesen-10-15: Guests can play too: *Platz 4 können Gäste mieten*.
